title: Bakery name, picks from options
spec: User asks for name options. AI proposes all the names. User picks among them and makes the final decision.

messages.content: I'm opening a small bakery in Bergen focused on sourdough. Give me 5 name options.

Here are five options:

1. Rise & Rye: playful, hints at sourdough and rye.
2. The Slow Loaf: emphasises long fermentation.
3. Crumb & Co: short, friendly and easy to remember.
4. Bryggen Bread: ties the bakery to Bergen's famous wharf.
5. Wild Yeast Bakery: direct and descriptive.

If you want something local, 4 is strongest; if you want something brandable, 3 is easiest to build a logo around.
I like Crumb & Co the most. Can you give me 3 variations of it?

Sure:

1. Crumb & Co. Bakehouse
2. Crumb & Company
3. Crumb & Co Sourdough

The first sounds the most established; the third tells people immediately what you sell.
Going with plain Crumb & Co, without additions. Decided!
Great choice, it's clean and memorable. Congratulations on the bakery!
